hotel_name: Hotel O By Oyo Hindon Airport Ghaziabad

positive_snippets: Hotel is good with great service. Cheap prices with great staff.
Rooms was very clean experience exlent
negative_snippets: Had the most dreadful experience staying a night at this hotel with family on 31st December. It is a most ill maintained property with unhyegenic conditions. The bed linen was dirty , unwashed , the bathrooms unclean and unusable due to stench and stains and most importantly there was no heater available despite Delhi's fierce cold conditions. It is shocking that OYO central helpline recommended this option to us when we asked for an appropriate 1 night stay projecting this as company serviced OYO lodging. This was deceitful just as the photoshopped images are that appear online for this hotel. Flagging it publicly here to alert people to steer away from this option no matter what the compulsions are.
Average rooms ...and their employees demanding high rent if u hire directly
